title: 1. Ultrasonic Distance & Traffic Light
description: Measures distance in cm and lights Green (≥50cm), Yellow (11–49cm), or blinking Red (≤10cm).
pins: HC-SR04: Trig=D7, Echo=D6 | TM1637: CLK=D2, DIO=D3 | LEDs: Green=D10, Yellow=D11, Red=D12

title: 2. Laser / Sensor Event Counter
description: Counts sensor triggers on the 4-digit display with a push-button reset.
pins: Sensor=D8 | Reset Switch=D9 | TM1637: CLK=D6, DIO=D7

title: 0. Board Test (Built-in LED Blink)
description: Use this first to test your USB cable and Arduino board.
pins: No external wiring required (uses onboard Pin 13 LED).
